actions.label: Moving through the Store
actions.description: walking or moving from one location to another, strafing from side to side is included

actions.label: Standing at the Shelf
actions.description: stationary in front of a shelf, slight movements don't count

actions.label: Standing at the Mirror
actions.description: statioinary at the mirror, slight movements don't count

actions.label: Standing at the Counter
actions.description: stationary at the counter, slight movements don't count

actions.label: Extending or Retracting Arm
actions.description: to pick or place a hat, the entire motion is included

actions.label: Holding Arm in front of Body
actions.description: to hold and inspect a hat

actions.label: Raising or Lowering Arm from Head
actions.description: to wear a hat, the entire motion is included

actions.label: Idle
actions.description: when arms rest to the side with no meaningful movement

actions.label: Interacting
actions.description: Verbal or physical (both active such as handing over items, gestures and passive such as being present nearby) interactions with shopkeeper

actions.label: Not Interacting
actions.description: If no shopkeeper is present nearby or has disengaged
